descriptor: Cross-Task Measurement-Sufficiency Transport, Representation×Task Difficulty Factorization, Zero-Shot Allocation-Policy Transfer, Shift-Robust Decision Preservation & Hosted-Inference Measurement-Law Externalization
question: Across independently schematized scientific tasks sharing the same R/F/H/T/L representation operators, does measurement difficulty retain a common representation-indexed component after task effects are removed?

primary_gemini_tests.historical_transport: 3 correlations: centered P51 Gemini q(v,0.50) vs each fresh-task tau(v)
primary_gemini_tests.loo_factorization: 3 correlations: each held-out task centered tau profile vs mean centered profile of the other two tasks

secondary_gptoss: Mirror the 3 fresh-task leave-one-task-out tests in a separate Holm family. No historical-field authority.
factorization: Report task, representation, and residual task×representation sums of squares on tau; interaction share descriptive only.
zero_shot_policy: Secondary falsifier only. Reuse frozen P51 Gemini q in the P52 field-guided rule on first 16 task draws; score against independent final 16 draws versus uniform and online-width comparators.
surviving_candidate: Prospective externalization of a previously reproduced hosted-inference stopping-difficulty field across independently schematized task families, separating task×representation factorization from operational allocation utility.
